Min 8 years in legislative or policy analysis, preferably in a higher education setting; and / or equivalent experience/training.

Under general direction, serves as the lead policy analyst and coordinator for the UC Controller's office policy portfolio. Manages the full lifecycle of department-owned policies, ensuring compliance with University of California policy governance requirements and established policy development standards. Provides expert consultation and project management for policy creation, revision, review, implementation, communication, and retirement activities. Researches, analyzes, and develops policy recommendations in response to regulatory, operational, financial, and organizational changes affecting the UC Controller's office and the broader UC system. Collaborates with policy sponsors, subject matter experts, executive leadership, campus and health system stakeholders, and the UC Office of the President Policy Coordination Office to ensure policies remain current, effective, and aligned with University objectives.

35% Policy Portfolio Management Serves as the primary administrator for the UC Controller's office full policy portfolio, including Presidential Policies. Manages the full policy lifecycle, including development, revision, scheduled review, approval, implementation, and retirement. Maintains the policy inventory, review calendar, project plans, documentation, and governance records. Ensures compliance with the UC Presidential Policy Owner Guidebook and established policy governance requirements.

30% Policy Analysis, Development & Governance Conducts policy analyses, drafts and edits complex policies and guidance documents, develops recommendations for leadership, evaluates policy effectiveness, and identifies opportunities for continuous improvement.

20% Stakeholder Engagement & Policy Coordination Leads collaboration with policy sponsors, executive leadership, subject matter experts, UCOP partners, and UC locations throughout the policy development and review process. Facilitates stakeholder consultations, comment resolution, approval workflows, and cross-functional working groups. Provides expert consultation on policy interpretation and governance requirements.

10% Policy Implementation, Communication & Training Develops and executes implementation strategies for new and revised policies. Creates communication plans, implementation guidance, FAQs, training materials, presentations, and other resources to promote consistent understanding and adoption of policies across the University. Monitors implementation progress and supports organizational change management efforts.

5% Strategic Initiatives & Continuous Improvement Leads or participates in special projects related to governance, compliance, financial operations, and organizational effectiveness. Develops metrics and reporting on policy portfolio health, recommends process improvements, and supports strategic initiatives that strengthen policy governance across the Controller's Office.
